description: Connected Automated Vehicles – Integrated Highway Prototype II (IHP2) is a data set deposited in ROSA P by its authors Jiaqi Ma, Leidos (United States). This dataset contains data collected from the IHP2 testing conducted in Florida. This data set contains up 3 different vehicle types with data saved in ROS bag format. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is United States Government Public Domain License. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
